title: analysis.pointers.scan request
description: Find runs of plausible in-hunk pointers and report what they address, writing nothing. `read_only`.

origin.description: The address the hunk is mapped at. A target is plausible when it lands inside `[origin, origin + hunk bytes)`, so this is the claim the scan tests.

minimum_entries.description: Consecutive plausible entries a run needs before it counts as a table. Three by default: two in-range longwords in a row happen by accident in ordinary data and three do so far less often.

word_scale.description: Read unsigned words scaled by this factor and added to the origin, instead of absolute longwords. A scale of zero is refused — it would decode every word to the origin.

maximum_targets.description: Cap on the targets reported per table. Each table always reports its true total and its full span beside the capped list.

maximum_entry_offsets.description: Cap on the derived entry offsets. Its own bound rather than the target cap's: the targets are what a table shows and the entry offsets are what a caller analyzes from, so narrowing the display must not narrow the analysis.
